data.desc: D-MARKET Electronic Services & Trading, operating primarily under the Hepsiburada brand, is one of Türkiye's leading e-commerce platforms, providing online retail, digital marketplace, payment, and logistics services. The company connects millions of consumers with merchants through a broad product offering including electronics, fashion, groceries, home goods, and personal care products. In addition to marketplace services, it operates digital payment and fulfillment solutions to improve customer experience and merchant efficiency. Recent company initiatives have focused on strengthening logistics infrastructure, fintech capabilities, and AI-driven customer engagement.
